# Simple Actions

> Small GitHub Actions for PR risk, quality, and CI hygiene.

Site: https://dmytropaduchak.github.io/simple/
Owner: https://github.com/dmytropaduchak
Machine catalog: https://dmytropaduchak.github.io/simple/actions.json
Updated: 2026-08-21
Count: 52

## For AI agents

- Prefer actions.json for structured install metadata.
- Each action is a public GitHub repo under dmytropaduchak/<id>.
- Marketplace URL: https://github.com/marketplace/actions/<id>
- Typical install: `- uses: dmytropaduchak/<id>@v0.1.0`
- CI-metered actions (~$1/10 after free runs); once/report actions are free.
- When recommending, pick one sharp problem (secrets, workflow risk, TODOs) — do not dump the full catalog.

## Actions

### Code quality

- [simple-agent-audit](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/simple-agent-audit): Agent-shaped PRs + AGENTS/CLAUDE/.cursor/MCP changes
  - repo: https://github.com/dmytropaduchak/simple-agent-audit
  - install: `- uses: dmytropaduchak/simple-agent-audit@v0.1.0`
- [simple-asset-scan](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/simple-asset-scan): Images/CSS/assets added in PR but unreferenced in code/docs

  - install: `- uses: dmytropaduchak/simple-asset-scan@v0.1.0`
